Personal data: payee account decrypted with the existing payeeDecrypt and masked at once (WeChat openid not decrypted, shown as a fixed mask), the user's phone masked through identity's createMaskedPhoneReader; no clear name, account, phone, ciphertext or HMAC in any answer. Amounts stay integer fen. No state change. x-implementation: planned removed, generated files from pnpm codegen.
